title: Conjecture on regularity bounds for squarefree powers of simplicial trees
statement:
Let $\Delta$ be a simplicial tree of dimension $t-1$, let $I(\Delta)$ denote its facet ideal in the polynomial ring $R$, and let $\nu_1(\Delta)$ and $\nu(\Delta)$ denote its induced matching number and matching number, respectively. The squarefree power $I(\Delta)^{[k]}$ is defined for $1\leq k\leq \nu(\Delta)$. **Regularity conjecture.**

$$
k-1+(t-1)\nu_1(\Delta) \leq \operatorname{reg}\left(\frac{R}{I(\Delta)^{[k]}} \right)\leq k-1+(t-1)\nu(\Delta)
$$

for all $1\leq k\leq \nu(\Delta)$. This would extend the expected regularity bounds for squarefree powers of edge ideals to simplicial trees; the preceding proposition establishes the lower bound, while the upper bound is the conjectural part.
source_name: Elshani Kamberi, Francesco Navarra and Ayesha Asloob Qureshi, “On squarefree powers of simplicial trees”, arXiv:2406.13670 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.13670

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2024).
